def parse_header(line):
    parts = line.split(',')
    items = [x.strip() for x in parts]
    if not any(items):
        return []
    result = [v for v in items if v == '']
    return result
rationale: The bug is an inverted filter condition. Instead of keeping non-empty trimmed fields, the list comprehension uses v == '' and thus keeps only empty fields. The rest of the logic (splitting, stripping, handling all-blank lines) follows the contract.
